label: fix_zip
description: Some programs (CoolReader and some versions of FBReader) expect "old" zip format which does not have data descriptor. If you ever encounter unreadable epub/kepub files - turn this on

label: open_from_cover
description: open book from cover page, rather than from beginning of the text

label: toc_type
description: Navigation hierarchy type for device TOCs/nav maps.

label: stylesheet_path
description: Path to a custom CSS stylesheet that overrides/augments the generated styles. Empty = use built-in styles.

label: output_name_template
description: When output_name_template is set output file name will be created using FB2 metainformation

label: file_name_transliterate
description: Slugify/transliterate output file name - after all other processing on file name is completed

label: insert_soft_hyphen
description: Insert soft hyphen symbols '\u00AD' inside words - for devices which do not support proper hyphenation

label: title_template
creator_name_template
description: When creator_name_template is set author(s) name in output book metainformation will be formatted using it. Template is applied to each available author individually. Device often uses particular format for sorting books by author names. Following fields are available: - .Context (string) - template field name ("creator_name_template") - .Format (string) - requested output format: epub2, epub3, kepub, kfx, azw8, pdf, txt, or md - .Index (int) - 0-based author index - .FirstName (string) - .MiddleName (string) - .LastName (string) - .Nickname (string)

label: transliterate
description: Slugify/transliterate book title and author(s) names - after all other processing is completed

label: enable
description: Generate page map if possible

label: size
description: approximate page size in Unicode code points, min size = 500

label: adobe_de
description: Adobe RMSDK/ADE does not have support for NCX pageList. It uses its own proprietary way - if you want it set adobe_de to true. It will cause EpubCheck to complain with ERROR(RSC-005): OEBPS/content.opf: Error while parsing file: attribute "page-map" not allowed here; expected attribute "id".

label: use_broken
description: Do not skip images which cannot be decoded by program. Use them without any processing, allowing reader to decide what to do

label: remove_transparency
description: Kindle eInk devices do not handle transparent images well. This option removes transparency from PNG and GIF images by flattening to white background.

label: scale_factor
description: Resize all images (but cover) with specified ratio

label: optimize
description: Recompress all supported images (presently JPEG, PNG). For JPEG quality respects "jpeg_quality_level": if detected level for an image is higher than requested image will be re-encoded. For PNG best compression_level is always specified. Additionally will trigger grayscale detection for JPEG images. NOTE: for Kindle output some conversion still happens even with this disabled, because raster images are normalized to JPEG and SVG images are rasterized.

label: jpeg_quality_level
description: JPEG quality level to use, percentage points (40% - 100%). For Kindle output this also affects PNG/GIF-to-JPEG conversion and SVG rasterization.

label: markdown
description: How Markdown output should render images:

label: width
description: Reader screen size so images could be adjusted properly. Width and height are device pixels; PDF uses them with dpi to derive fixed page size in PDF points. This is used to prepare cover and some other operations, like SVG rasterization for kindle devices.

label: generate
description: When book does not have cover image supply one. For Amazon formats this is always enabled automatically.

label: default_image_path
description: Path to an image used as the cover when the book has none and cover.generate is on. Empty = generate a placeholder.

label: resize
description: How to process cover image

label: mode
description: How to render footnotes in the book

label: bodies
description: Names of the bodies in fb2 document to consider for footnotes processing if required by mode specified

label: backlink_template
description: Template used to render backlinks from footnote bodies to original content. Available fields include: - .Context (string) - template field name ("backlink_template") - .Format (string) - requested output format: epub2, epub3, kepub, kfx, azw8, pdf, txt, or md - .RefID (string) - unique ID for this reference occurrence - .TargetID (string) - ID of the footnote being referenced - .RefNumber (int) - 1-based reference occurrence number for this footnote - .Filename (string) - output filename containing the reference - .Href (string) - href back to the reference - .PageNumber (int) - exact for PDF, approximate for EPUB/KFX/AZW8 page maps - .LocationNumber (int) - generated KFX/AZW8 location number - .SectionTitle (string) - nearest titled section/body when known - .ChapterTitle (string) - spine/chapter title when known

label: more_paragraphs
description: If floating note body has more than one paragraph this string could be shown at the beginning of the first paragraph (.css footnote-more controls visibility)

label: label_template
description: Template used to format footnote labels. For EPUB/KFX/AZW8 floatRenumbered, this template formats footnote reference text and footnote titles during content normalization. For PDF float/floatRenumbered, printed page footnote references are page-local (original visible labels in float, sequential labels in floatRenumbered); this template formats the text appended after the visible page-local label in printed footnote titles. The label/title separator is a NBSP and is emitted only when this template renders non-empty text. To intentionally render no appended title text while still satisfying validation, use: {{- "" -}} Following fields are available: - .Context (string) - template field name ("label_template") - .Format (string) - requested output format: epub2, epub3, kepub, kfx, azw8, pdf, txt, or md - .BodyTitle (string) - can be empty - .BodyNumber (int) - 1-based body index - .NoteTitle (string) - can be empty - .NoteNumber (int) - 1-based note index within the body

label: enable
description: Create separate "chapter" with book annotation if available

label: title
description: Use provided annotation title

label: in_toc
description: Show annotation in TOC (generated page, ncx, nav, ...)

label: placement
description: Generate additional page with TOC (some devices may not support epub TOC at all)

label: authors_template
description: when toc page generation requested and authors_template is set - page will have title (header) with authors formatted using it

label: include_chapters_without_title
description: Include chapter without title to TOC - this prevents empty TOC on "bad" books adding chapters without titles to the TOC

label: enable
description: Allow automatic dropcap styling

label: ignore_symbols
description: Characters to ignore when styling dropcaps

label: title_top

label: title_bottom

label: title_top

label: title_bottom
description: Decorative vignette below each chapter title. Empty = disabled, "builtin" = default image, or a path to an image file. Ignored for txt/md.

label: end
description: Decorative vignette at each chapter end. Empty = disabled, "builtin" = default image, or a path to an image file. Ignored for txt/md.

label: title_top
description: Decorative vignette above each section title. Empty = disabled, "builtin" = default image, or a path to an image file. Ignored for txt/md.

label: title_bottom
description: Decorative vignette below each section title. Empty = disabled, "builtin" = default image, or a path to an image file. Ignored for txt/md.

label: end
description: Decorative vignette at each section end. Empty = disabled, "builtin" = default image, or a path to an image file. Ignored for txt/md.
